scoring_justification: Full recomputation of the MD simulation pipeline in the verifier is infeasible. The verifier checks (i) that the reported final polymorph fractions at P10 and P50 are within tolerance of paper-reported reference values (structural with value tolerance), (ii) that the expected trends hold (bcc increases with pressure, fcc decreases), and (iii) for temperature variation, cross-nucleation trends (hcp ratio and slope ratio) are verified without requiring hidden gold. This combination of tolerant value checks and trend verification adequately captures the paper's claims.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold polymorph composition percentages for P=10 and P=50
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper: P10 fcc 55%, hcp 25%, bcc 20%; P50 fcc ~0%, bcc 85%, hcp remainder 15% (Fig. 1 and text).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported approximate percentages.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported values; the task reproduces these observations.

outputs.description: Final polymorph composition percentages for P=10 and P=50, plus the bcc-liquid coexistence line from thermodynamic integration, enabling verification of the occurrence domain of the metastable bcc polymorph.
Average number of hcp particles versus crystallite size for supercoolings 22% and 10% at fixed pressure P=5.68, demonstrating cross-nucleation control.

output_contract.notes: The scored quantities are compared against paper-reported reference values with appropriate tolerances and trend checks. The bcc-liquid coexistence line is additionally checked to confirm that the state points P=10 (outside domain) and P=50 (inside domain) lie on the correct sides of the line.
